prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic medium-format portrait in a dim ancient pigment laboratory with rich magenta couture and artisan tools.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with intense gaze, visible freckles, dark period-styled hair, avant-garde berry-and-gold makeup, monumental deep-magenta raw-silk ruffled collar, opaque muted-red blouse, and antique handcrafted brushes held safely near the collarbone.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 central shoulders-up portrait, brushes leading toward the eyes, deep burgundy void, blurred wooden shelving, floating dust, symmetrical editorial framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic chiaroscuro carving skin pores and silk weave, deep burgundy shadows, tactile laboratory mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 800 grain, ultra-shallow depth of field, razor-sharp eyes, realistic brush and fabric detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 9:16 medium-format editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with dark period-styled hair, intense gaze and freckles visible through berry-and-gold makeup, monumental deep-magenta raw-silk ruffled collar, opaque muted-red blouse, antique handcrafted brushes held safely near the collarbone, dim ancient pigment laboratory, deep burgundy shadows, chiaroscuro, Hasselblad H6D-100c 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 800 grain, razor-sharp eyes, no text.
